Apple___Apple_scab.dosage: Spray every 7-10 days from green tip stage until petals fall.

Apple___Black_rot.pesticide: Prune infected branches and apply Captan fungicide.
Apple___Black_rot.dosage: 2 tablespoons per gallon applied during the pink bud stage.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.dosage: Spray when blossom buds show pink and repeat every 7-10 days.

Blueberry___healthy.dosage: Maintain soil acidity (pH 4.5-5.5) and routine watering.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.pesticide: Apply Sulfur or Potassium Bicarbonate sprays.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.dosage: Spray every 10-14 days at first sign of white powdery spots.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.dosage: Ensure good air circulation and routine watering.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.dosage: Apply at tasseling (VT stage) if lesions reach the ear leaf.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust.dosage: Spray when pustules first appear on leaves, repeating after 7-14 days.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.dosage: Apply before tasseling if lesions are actively spreading.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.dosage: Maintain proper nitrogen levels and soil moisture.

Grape___Black_rot.dosage: Spray every 10-14 days starting when shoots are 2-4 inches long.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).pesticide: No effective chemical cure. Prune out infected wood.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).dosage: Burn or discard infected wood immediately. Apply wound sealant after pruning.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.dosage: Spray after harvest to protect foliage and reduce overwintering spores.

Grape___healthy.dosage: Maintain canopy management for adequate airflow.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).pesticide: Control Asian citrus psyllid vector with Imidacloprid.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).dosage: Apply as a soil drench prior to new flush growth. Remove severely infected trees.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.dosage: Apply Copper at leaf drop in fall, and Oxytetracycline starting at petal fall.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.pesticide: Apply Copper fungicides mixed with Mancozeb.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.dosage: Spray every 7-10 days during warm, wet weather.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.dosage: Maintain even soil moisture and monitor for aphids.

Potato___Early_blight.pesticide: Apply Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil based fungicides.
Potato___Early_blight.dosage: Spray every 7-10 days upon first sign of leaf spots; ensure complete foliage coverage.

Potato___Late_blight.dosage: Apply every 5-7 days during wet weather conditions.

Raspberry___healthy.dosage: Prune old canes after harvest to maintain airflow.

Soybean___healthy.dosage: Monitor for root rot in poorly drained soils.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.pesticide: Apply Neem oil, Sulfur, or Potassium Bicarbonate.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.dosage: Spray thoroughly on upper and lower leaf surfaces every 7-10 days.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.pesticide: Apply protective fungicides like Captan or Myclobutanil.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.dosage: Spray every 7-14 days starting at early bloom. Ensure good weed control for airflow.

Strawberry___healthy.dosage: Maintain mulch layer to keep fruit off the soil.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.pesticide: Apply Copper fungicides mixed with Mancozeb.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.dosage: Spray every 7-10 days, avoiding overhead watering.

Tomato___Early_blight.pesticide: Apply Mancozeb or Copper-based fungicides. Remove infected lower leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.dosage: Spray every 7-14 days starting when disease first appears.

Tomato___Late_blight.pesticide: Apply Copper fungicide or Chlorothalonil immediately.
Tomato___Late_blight.dosage: 1 tablespoon per gallon of water, applied every 7 days until harvest.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.dosage: Improve ventilation in greenhouses; spray every 7-10 days if symptoms spread.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.dosage: Spray every 7-10 days upon first sign of spots on lower leaves.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.pesticide: Apply Horticultural oil, Neem oil, or Miticides.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.dosage: Spray every 5-7 days, focusing heavily on the undersides of leaves.

Tomato___Target_Spot.dosage: Spray every 7-14 days; ensure adequate spacing between plants.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.pesticide: Control whitefly vectors using Insecticidal soap or Imidacloprid.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.dosage: No cure for the virus. Remove and destroy infected plants immediately to prevent spread.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.dosage: Remove and destroy infected plants. Wash hands and tools thoroughly to prevent mechanical transmission.

Tomato___healthy.dosage: Maintain consistent watering and stake plants to keep leaves off the ground.
